name: B10-0424/2026 – § 22 – Am 136
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 22.Invites the Member States to strengthen cooperation between competent national authorities and to make full use of Schengen cooperation instruments and the relevant European databases, in compliance with EU law, in order to identify networks, relay structures, associated or reconstituted entities, cross-border modes of operation, movements, invitations, events, partnerships or activities likely to contribute to the structuring or reconstitution of extremist networks in Europe;
